Class C2paValidator

java.lang.Object
de.christianmahnke.jc2pa.C2paValidator
All Implemented Interfaces:
Validator
@AutoService(Validator.class) public class C2paValidator extends Object implements Validator
Module-owned info.json semantics for C2PA Content Credentials (C2paTileSink.C2PA_PROFILE_URI).

Checks service entries claiming the C2PA profile: the C2PA JSON-LD context must be present in a V3 @context array, and an advertised trustAnchor must be an absolute URI. Entries with other profiles are ignored.
